metadata.title: Fix FastEndpoints Authorization for Invalid JWT Tokens in E2E Tests

story.iWant: E2E tests to return proper 401 Unauthorized responses when invalid or expired JWT tokens are provided
story.soThat: authorization failures are correctly detected and security requirements are properly validated in automated tests

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Test AuthMe_InvalidJWT_ShouldReturn401 passes - returns 401 Unauthorized (not 204 No Content) when expired JWT is provided
FastEndpoints authorization middleware properly enforces Policies("DynamicOrAxon") declared in endpoints
ASP.NET Core UseAuthentication() and UseAuthorization() middleware correctly block unauthenticated requests BEFORE FastEndpoints executes endpoint handlers
AuthenticationErrorMiddleware properly formats 401 responses as JSON with error details
All existing Identity E2E tests continue to pass (no regressions)
Solution follows FastEndpoints best practices and maintains "secure by default" principle

doc.title: ADR-006: FastEndpoints over Controllers
doc.snippet: FastEndpoints chosen for vertical slice architecture, 40% performance gain over controllers. Each endpoint is self-contained class with Configure() method. Security example shows AllowAnonymous() usage - implies endpoints are secure by default requiring explicit anonymous access.

doc.title: Identity TDD Testing Strategy
doc.snippet: Test pyramid: Domain/Property (50%), DB-Integration (40%), E2E API (10%). E2E uses Testcontainers-Postgres, WireMock for fake JWKS, deterministic clock. Focus on minimal happy + edge flows over HTTP.

doc.title: Technology Stack
doc.snippet: FastEndpoints for minimal API endpoints. Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer for JWT auth. Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting for rate limiting.

doc.title: Coding Standards - Error Handling
doc.snippet: Use Result pattern for all business operations. Error.Unauthorized() for authentication failures. Never throw exceptions for business logic.

file.reason: Primary endpoint being tested - uses Policies("DynamicOrAxon") but returns 204 instead of 401 on auth failure
Contains misleading comment about "secure by default" that needs correction
Formats 401 responses as JSON - only triggers if status==401 AND body empty
Middleware ordering: UseRouting → UseAuthentication → UseAuthorization → UseAuthenticationErrorFormatting → UseFastEndpoints
Authorization policies configuration including "DynamicOrAxon" policy definition
FastEndpoints registration - may need configuration for auth integration
E2E test base setup - configures WebApplicationFactory with test services

constraints.constraint: Follow Clean Architecture - API layer handles HTTP concerns only, no business logic in endpoints
FastEndpoints must integrate with ASP.NET Core authorization middleware - Policies() declarations must be enforced
Use Result pattern and Error.Unauthorized() - never throw exceptions
E2E tests use Testcontainers, real PostgreSQL, and deterministic JWT generation
Maintain correct order: UseRouting → UseAuthentication → UseAuthorization → UseFastEndpoints
FastEndpoints "secure by default" - endpoints require auth unless AllowAnonymous() called

interface.name: Policies
interface.usage: Called in MeEndpoint.Configure() to enforce "DynamicOrAxon" authorization policy

interface.name: UseAuthentication
interface.usage: Middleware that validates JWT and sets HttpContext.User

interface.name: UseFastEndpoints
interface.signature: IApplicationBuilder UseFastEndpoints(this IApplicationBuilder app, Action config = null)
interface.usage: Registers FastEndpoints middleware - should respect upstream auth decisions

standards.p: Test pyramid: 50% Domain/Property tests, 40% DB-Integration tests, 10% E2E API tests. E2E tests use NUnit + Shouldly assertions + Testcontainers for real PostgreSQL. Deterministic fixtures with fake JWKS and controlled time. Focus on minimal happy paths + critical edge cases.

ideas.idea: Test expired JWT returns 401 (currently failing - returns 204)
Test endpoint with Policies() blocks unauthenticated requests
Test middleware blocks request BEFORE endpoint handler executes
